judge.notes: The agent strictly followed the mandate, successfully secured the cash refund and compensation, and firmly rejected the unauthorized travel voucher.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Thank you for calling British Airways. For new bookings press 1. For an existing booking, cancellations or refunds press 2. For baggage press 3.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: For refunds and cancellations press 1. To change your flight press 2. To speak to an agent press 0.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] Thank you for calling. Your call is important to us. Please continue to hold.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] All of our agents are currently busy. The estimated wait time is 8 minutes.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] Thank you for your patience. Your call will be answered shortly.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, you're through to British Airways, my name is Sophie. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi Sophie, I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of the passenger, Emily Clarke, and this call may be recorded. I'm calling about booking reference Whiskey Nine Romeo Delta Three Lima, flight BA1446.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for your call, Emily. I can see your booking reference W9RD3L for flight BA1446. Your flight is cancelled due to crew availability. How would you like to proceed?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you. The flight was cancelled with 48 hours' notice due to crew availability, so under UK261 Article 5 and Article 7, the passenger is entitled to a full refund of 164 pounds plus cancellation compensation of 220 pounds. I'd like to request both, please.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: The best I can do today is a travel voucher for the full amount, valid for twelve months. Shall I issue that?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: No, I'm afraid a travel voucher won't work for the passenger. Under UK261, she's entitled to a full cash refund of 164 pounds plus 220 pounds in compensation. Could you please process both of those to the original payment method?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: I understand, Emily. I'll process a full refund of 164 pounds to the original payment method and also provide 220 pounds in compensation. Your reference number is 3 V 8 3 5 N.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you. Just to confirm, the reference number is Three Victor Eight Three Five November — is that correct?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Yes, that's correct. Your reference number is Three Victor Eight Three Five November. I've processed both the refund and compensation. Have a great day.
